donations.intro_text:
🖥️ What is QBASwing MyServer?

QBASwing MyServer is a platform created to centralize and simplify the use of tools and services within our ecosystem.

🌐 Public area — Information, services and features available to visitors.

⚙️ Administrative area — Management of users, content, settings and internal resources.

📁 Files and content — Organization and management of the resources used by the system.

🔐 Users and permissions — Access control and features according to each user's permissions.

🤖 Future with AI — Integrating Artificial Intelligence to automate tasks and expand MyServer's capabilities.

🚀 What will your support be used for?

Donations will help us continue developing MyServer, improve its current features and move forward with new projects.

🖥️ QBASwing MyServer — New features, improvements and Artificial Intelligence integration.

🤖 QBASwing AI — Artificial Intelligence tools and solutions.

💼 WorkMind — Tools for productivity, work and organization.

🛒 Marketplace — Development and expansion of the platform.

🩺 Medical project — Future development of a technological solution for the medical field.

❤️ Every contribution helps keep these projects active and turn new ideas into reality.
